question: Where’s the closest museum that comes up heading toward Chestatee Overlook, Dahlonega, GA from Yellow River Game Ranch, Lilburn, GA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois AS p WHERE p.museum IS NOT NULL AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Chestatee Overlook%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Dahlonega%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) < ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Yellow River Game Ranch%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lilburn%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Chestatee Overlook%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Dahlonega%' LIMIT 1 )::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
